race.title: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: FEEL THE NEED wasted no time getting back on the up when second over C&D 2 weeks ago and he'll surely go very close again from 1 lb higher. A well-run 7f on soft ground suits Stanage so he's second choice, ahead of Ghisa . FEEL THE NEED STANAGE GHISA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Feel The Need (4/1), Ghisa (5/1), Charlie Mason (5/1), Stanage (6/1), Fifty Nifty (7/1), It Just Takes Time (10/1), Miss Lady Grace (12/1), Skewsby (14/1), Decem Starr (16/1), Pol Roger (16/1), Jel Pepper (20/1), King's Call (20/1)
